dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Have you heard what our envoys to Inazuma have been saying? They sent a letter recently, saying that the Inazuma Shogunate has gone to war with the rebels!

dialogues.speaker: Lyudmila
dialogues.text: Rebels... A war... Our comrades in Inazuma won't be caught in the crossfire, will they?

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Hah, I doubt it. We Fatui are official foreign envoys in Inazuma, and there's a Harbinger with us, too. We shan't be so easily swept up in their internal squabbles!

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Ah, Inazuma. They call it the eternal nation, but they can't even settle their own disputes. Now that's a good joke if I ever heard one!

dialogues.speaker: Lyudmila
dialogues.text: Regardless, a war is always going to be a highly volatile factor.

dialogues.speaker: Lyudmila
dialogues.text: If Inazuma, one of the Seven Nations, is truly in trouble, it may yet affect the progress of Her Majesty the Tsaritsa's grand design...

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Oh, there you go again. How could Inazuma not hacking it affect our mighty motherland Snezhnaya?

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: If anything, I'd say that the chaos there is a great opportunity for us to get things done.

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Hey, have you heard what our superiors have been saying? The Vision Hunt Decree that Inazuma was strictly enforcing has been abolished!

dialogues.speaker: Lyudmila
dialogues.text: The Vision Hunt Decree... Wasn't that something that the Electro Archon promulgated herself? To think that even one so exalted as an Archon could change their mind...

dialogues.speaker: Lyudmila
dialogues.text: Well, the more shocking thing I've heard is that Lady Signora, the Eighth of the Harbingers, was...

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Well, about that... I think that some sacrifices were inevitable on the path of Her Majesty's great work.

dialogues.speaker: Lyudmila
dialogues.text: But Lady Signora's a Harbinger... What happened, I wonder, that she wound up losing her life?

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Who knows? People change, after all. Perhaps her strength was insufficient to remain a Harbinger. I don't believe that such a thing would have happened to her otherwise...

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Just you wait. I'm sure that our Eighth seat will be filled by someone even more powerful. And when that happens, we Fatui will be all the stronger for it!

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Hey, have you heard what our superiors have been saying? Inazuma, long under the Sakoku Decree, has become an open country again!

dialogues.speaker: Lyudmila
dialogues.text: What? Did they seriously abolish it?

dialogues.speaker: Lyudmila
dialogues.text: First the Vision Hunt Decree, and now the Sakoku Decree... These were both the direct decrees of the Electro Archon. Is she preparing to do something big soon?

dialogues.speaker: Lyudmila
dialogues.text: Oh no. If the Electro Archon plans to involve herself in external affairs again, won't this affect our influence over Teyvat?

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Oh, come on, you're being such a worrywart.

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: With Her Majesty the Tsaritsa on our side, Snezhnaya's eternal greatness is assured! There's absolutely no reason for us to worry!

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: In fact, I'd say that Inazuma opening up is instead a great opportunity for us Fatui to expand our strength there.

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Indeed, everything that's happening is well within our control!

dialogues.speaker: Lyudmila
dialogues.text: Well, I sure hope you're right...

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Hey, have you heard that mining operations seem to have resumed in The Chasm of Liyue? The area has been sealed for quite some time.

dialogues.speaker: Lyudmila
dialogues.text: Do you mean to say that The Chasm is now open to ordinary citizens?

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Not yet 100% open I presume, but small-scale mining is allowed there. Still, they wouldn't let ordinary people go in.

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: But we're the powerful Fatui — they'll definitely green light our actions!

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: But I heard that people can feel some strange shaking from deep down in The Chasm. It doesn't seem to be caused by mining.

dialogues.speaker: Lyudmila
dialogues.text: That doesn't sound good. I've heard long ago that they dug something ominous up from The Chasm. Is the rumor true...

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Hmm, the way I see it, there's no need to worry too much about it.

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Perhaps it's just an ordinary Ley Line phenomenon, or perhaps it's because the Qixing did something.

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: We'll find out when the people we sent earlier come back!

dialogues.speaker: Lyudmila
dialogues.text: Um... Let's hope they can return safe and sound...

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Heh. Have you heard? It seems that the Sumeru Akademiya has made a real mess of one of their big projects!

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: The Six Darshans have been left leaderless as a result, which has forced the weak Dendro Archon to take over.

dialogues.speaker: Lyudmila
dialogues.text: Wait, so do you mean that something terrible has happened?

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Terrible? No, not at all. It's wonderful news, in fact!

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: I've heard that Lord Dottore managed to infiltrate Sumeru during the chaos and perform a great work in the Tsaritsa's name with almost no effort at all!

dialogues.speaker: Lyudmila
dialogues.text: Huh... Then what about Lord Scaramouche? I've heard that he was recently seen in Sumeru as well...

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Lord Scaramouche? Ah, you mean the one with the famously bad temper? To be honest, I've heard that he hasn't been seen since his assignment in Inazuma.

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Are you suggesting that he might be related to the project in Sumeru as well?

dialogues.speaker: Lyudmila
dialogues.text: I'm not sure, really. But it seems that a lot of the soldiers under his command have been transferred elsewhere...

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Huh. Hmm... Well, you know, transfers happen all time, so who knows if those things are related at all?

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Anyway, I doubt that this will take away anything from the results that Lord Dottore has gotten this time!

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Heh. Have you heard? It seems that the Sumeru Akademiya has made a real mess of one of their big projects!

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: The Six Darshans have been left leaderless as a result, which has forced the weak Dendro Archon to take over.

dialogues.speaker: Lyudmila
dialogues.text: Wait, so do you mean that something terrible has happened?

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Terrible? No, not at all. It's wonderful news, in fact!

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: I've heard that Lord Dottore managed to infiltrate Sumeru during the chaos and perform a great work in the Tsaritsa's name with almost no effort at all!

dialogues.speaker: Lyudmila
dialogues.text: Is that so... Just as expected from the Second Harbinger...

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Huh? You don't seem happy, judging by your tone.

dialogues.speaker: Lyudmila
dialogues.text: It is indeed good that the Harbinger succeeded, but I'm reminded that Lady Signora also succeeded at Inazuma only to...

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Look at you. You're worrying too much. From how I see it, we don't have many people, and that's fine.

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: With someone as powerful as Lord Dottore among our ranks, it shouldn't matter if the rest of our seats remain empty.

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: But enough about the Eighth Harbinger. It is said that the Sixth Harbinger's seat has been left vacant for hundreds of years. Is that not cause for concern?

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Hey, did you hear? That prophecy that had everyone in Fontaine worried came true!

dialogues.speaker: Lyudmila
dialogues.text: Wait, so does that mean something terrible happened?

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Well, for Fontainians, there's good news and there's bad news.

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: The good news is that nobody dissolved in the water. The bad news is that there was still a huge flood.

dialogues.speaker: Lyudmila
dialogues.text: I see... So, did Lady Arlecchino...

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Nothing to worry about! The Knave came out on top, didn't take a single loss!

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: In fact, she even obtained the Hydro Archon's Gnosis for the Tsaritsa because she helped the Court of Fontaine!

dialogues.speaker: Lyudmila
dialogues.text: For real? But I heard that Master Childe was badly hurt during the flood...

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Master Childe? There's even less of a need to worry about him.

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: He's famous for his combat abilities. I'm sure he'll be up and about soon!

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Did you hear what happened with The Captain?

dialogues.speaker: Lyudmila
dialogues.text: Ah... I heard a few whispers. Apparently, the Tsaritsa has decided to keep his position as-is...

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: The Captain must have had his reasons for doing what he did, and the Abyss is not a foe to be taken lightly...

dialogues.speaker: Lyudmila
dialogues.text: What's this? A rare lapse in your bullish optimism?

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: ...Well, he did manage to earn everyone a valuable reprieve, including us, wouldn't you say?

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: And I've heard tell from our returning comrades that there's something wrong with the sky above Natlan.

dialogues.speaker: Lyudmila
dialogues.text: Ah! Has an even greater calamity befallen us?

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Perhaps a calamity, or perhaps an opportunity... Why else would the powers that be suddenly dispatch more hands to a place like Nod-Krai?

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Hey, have you heard? Something serious has happened with the higher-ups...

dialogues.speaker: Lyudmila
dialogues.text: Ah... you mean what happened with The Doctor and Marionette, right?

dialogues.speaker: Lyudmila
dialogues.text: *sigh* For this to happen just as the pl{RUBY#[D]Project Stuzha}an was about to kick off...

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Look at you, worrying over nothing again, aren't you?

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: The Jester and The Rooster are leading the charge on that front. There's no way it could fail.

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: No matter what happens in Nod-Krai, it won't affect Her Majesty the Tsaritsa's great endeavor. We need only carry out our duties and wait to sing the praises of her farsighted wisdom, you'll see!

dialogues.speaker: Lyudmila
dialogues.text: Hmm... I hope things really do go smoothly over in Snezhnograd...

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Hey, did you hear what the informants have been saying? Apparently, the Knights of Favonius weren't working alone when they resolved the Stormterror crisis. They had other people working in the shadows!

dialogues.speaker: Lyudmila
dialogues.text: So you're telling me there's a third faction we have to worry about now? The Fatui, the Knights of Favonius, and now these guys? This is not good news...

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: I think there's an opportunity here. The people of Mondstadt don't currently know who these mysterious actors were, so...

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: ...All we need to do is dress it up a little. Run some propaganda about how the Fatui rushed to Mondstadt's aid in their time of need, resolving the Stormterror crisis once and for all... *smug laugh*

dialogues.speaker: Lyudmila
dialogues.text: That could be risky. If they saw through the propaganda, they'd end up even more mistrustful of us...

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: There's no need to worry about the Fatui's propaganda capabilities, they know what they're doing. And in any case, given how powerful the Fatui is, who would dare question us!?

dialogues.speaker: Lyudmila
dialogues.text: Hmm... Well, I wish us the best of luck...

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: I'm telling you, everything will be fine! Stop worrying!

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Hey, did you get the word from the higher-ups? Bunch of masked bandits broke into one of our strongholds and tore the place up!

dialogues.speaker: Lyudmila
dialogues.text: You mean someone else is out to get us now? This is not great...

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: It's too early to say. We're still not sure on the identities or affiliations of these masked intruders...

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: It could be the Abyss Order. Or it could be the Knights of Favonius, just working outside the system.

dialogues.speaker: Lyudmila
dialogues.text: Well, whoever it is, we're the enemy to them, so we need to be on our guard...

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: It's fine. If it turns out the Knights of Favonius are ready to throw our good will back in our faces, they will find out soon enough just where the limit of their strength is!

dialogues.speaker: Lyudmila
dialogues.text: I just hope all our efforts in Mondstadt won't go to waste...

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Don't worry about it! The Fatui can handle this, no problem!

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Hey, have you heard what the Knights of Favonius have been saying? They're claiming they've defeated Stormterror!

dialogues.speaker: Lyudmila
dialogues.text: You know, I have been thinking — the Knights of Favonius can't be as impotent as they look. I'll bet they've been keeping their true power hidden until now...

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Hmph. Well, whatever secret weapons they might have stashed away, there's still no way they can compete with the might of the Fatui!

dialogues.speaker: Lyudmila
dialogues.text: It's a pity our previous attempts to coerce the Acting Grand Master were unsuccessful...

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Ah, it's not a big problem. Didn't you notice about Signora? She didn't seem concerned about this minor quibble in the slightest. In fact, she seemed quite pleased with herself about something.

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: About something she's done... Or maybe something she intends to do...

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Either way — we've got Signora at the helm, and even Barbatos himself would be no match for her!

dialogues.speaker: Lyudmila
dialogues.text: Well let's just hope Signora never meets her match in battle...

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Relax! This is Signora we're talking about. As long as she's around, everything will be fine.

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Hey, have you heard the news from our comrades in Liyue? Their archon's keeled over and died! Don't know if it's definitely true, but my word... Hahaha...

dialogues.speaker: Lyudmila
dialogues.text: What a tragic loss. It makes you think, doesn't it? Imagine if one of us were to—

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Stop! Not another word! I get that you're a pessimist, but this topic is off-limits!

dialogues.speaker: Lyudmila
dialogues.text: I was just making conversation, I didn't mean anything by it...

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: We should focus on our part. If our comrades in Liyue are making their move, we need to make preparations here, too.

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Things may or may not kick off in Mondstadt too. If they do, it'll be time for the Fatui to show our loyalty to Her Majesty the Tsaritsa!

dialogues.speaker: Lyudmila
dialogues.text: May the Tsaritsa always remain in good health...

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Hey! Snap out of it, will you!

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Hey, you heard what the Liyue merchants have been saying? It's true — their archon's really gone and died. They did a whole funeral and everything!

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: If you think about it, that's a good thing for the Fatui. This is likely to cause major upheaval in Liyue...

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: If we can take advantage of the power vacuum during the ensuing chaos...

dialogues.speaker: Lyudmila
dialogues.text: But we'll just have to wait and see whether this is ultimately good or bad news.

dialogues.speaker: Lyudmila
dialogues.text: It may cause difficulties for us. Economically, for instance — Liyue is the biggest trading hub in Teyvat after all...

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: What's the worst that could happen? You're worrying over nothing. Snezhnaya's economy is rock-solid, so we won't be affected.
